usedFor: Asyntai AI Chatbot talks to visitors, and MSG91 gets a ticket through “Send Mail via Hello” on a help request.

bestTemplate.name: “New Human Help Request” in Asyntai AI Chatbot, then “Send Mail via Hello” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: When a visitor asks for a person, the ticket opens in MSG91 so your team can pick it up.

watchOut: “Send Mail via Hello” creates a ticket or replies with a ticket ID, so check which one your step does.
